```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# ---- inputs ----
call_cols_ppmSeq_multiread <- c(
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread_30x",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread_100x",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread_200x"
)

call_cols_ppmSeq_singleton <- c(
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC_30x",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC_100x",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC_200x"
)

# truth axes: exclude PPM evidence + exclude PTA
#truth_cols <- c(
#  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
#  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
#  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
#  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ"
#)

truth_cols <- c(
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
  "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ"
)


# ---- helper: parse depth label ----
depth_label <- function(call_col) {
  if (str_detect(call_col, "_30x$"))  return("30x")
  if (str_detect(call_col, "_100x$")) return("100x")
  if (str_detect(call_col, "_200x$")) return("200x")
  "Full"
}

type_label <- function(call_col) {
  if (str_detect(call_col, "multiread")) "multiread" else "singleton"
}

# ---- compute truth once ----
df0 <- filt %>%
  mutate(
    truth = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(truth_cols), ~ .x == 1), na.rm = TRUE) >= 1
  )

# ---- compute confusion + metrics for a set of call cols ----
score_calls <- function(call_cols) {
  bind_rows(lapply(call_cols, function(cc) {
    pred <- df0[[cc]] == 1

    TP <- sum(pred &  df0$truth, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(pred & !df0$truth, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(!pred &  df0$truth, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(!pred & !df0$truth, na.rm = TRUE)

    precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA_real_ else TP / (TP + FP)
    recall    <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA_real_ else TP / (TP + FN)
    f1        <- if (is.na(precision) || is.na(recall) || (precision + recall) == 0) NA_real_
                 else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

    tibble(
      call_col = cc,
      depth = depth_label(cc),
      ppm_type = type_label(cc),
      TP = TP, FP = FP, FN = FN, TN = TN,
      precision = precision,
      recall = recall,
      F1 = f1
    )
  }))
}

res <- bind_rows(
  score_calls(call_cols_ppmSeq_multiread),
  score_calls(call_cols_ppmSeq_singleton)
) %>%
  mutate(depth = factor(depth, levels = c("30x","100x","200x","Full"))) %>%
  arrange(ppm_type, depth)

res
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# -----------------------------
# helper
# -----------------------------
depth_label <- function(call_col) {
  if (str_detect(call_col, "_30x$"))  return("30x")
  if (str_detect(call_col, "_100x$")) return("100x")
  if (str_detect(call_col, "_200x$")) return("200x")
  "Full"
}

type_label <- function(call_col) {
  if (str_detect(call_col, "multiread")) "multiread" else "singleton_HC"
}

# -----------------------------
# truth definitions
# -----------------------------
truth_map <- list(
  Any4 = c("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA",
           "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ",
           "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ",
           "is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ"),
  Illumina = c("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_ILLUMINA"),
  UDSeq = c("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_UDSEQ"),
  NanoSeq = c("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_NANOSEQ"),
  HiDEFseq = c("is_existing_lower_ci_0001_DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ")
)

call_cols <- c(call_cols_ppmSeq_multiread,
               call_cols_ppmSeq_singleton)

# -----------------------------
# compute TP / FP only
# -----------------------------
res_prec <- bind_rows(lapply(call_cols, function(cc) {

  pred <- filt[[cc]] == 1
  n_calls <- sum(pred, na.rm = TRUE)

  bind_rows(lapply(names(truth_map), function(tname) {

    truth_mat <- filt[, truth_map[[tname]], drop = FALSE]
    truth <- rowSums(truth_mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1

    TP <- sum(pred & truth, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(pred & !truth, na.rm = TRUE)

    precision <- if ((TP+FP)==0) NA_real_ else TP/(TP+FP)

    tibble(
      call_col = cc,
      depth = depth_label(cc),
      ppm_type = type_label(cc),
      truth_def = tname,
      TP = TP,
      FP = FP,
      n_calls = TP + FP,
      precision = precision,
      FDR = 1 - precision
    )

  }))

})) %>%
  mutate(
    depth = factor(depth, levels = c("30x","100x","200x","Full"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# 1️⃣ Precision line plot
# -----------------------------
ggplot(res_prec,
       aes(x=depth, y=precision,
           color=truth_def, group=truth_def)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=0.9) +
  geom_point(size=2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ppm_type) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  labs(y="Precision", x="Depth", color="Truth")

# -----------------------------
# 3️⃣ TP count
# -----------------------------
ggplot(res_prec,
       aes(x=depth, y=TP,
           color=truth_def, group=truth_def)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=0.9) +
  geom_point(size=2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ppm_type) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  labs(y="BAM-level validation count (TP)", x="Depth", color="Truth")

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ---- depth tick labels with (calls=...) for each ppm_type ----
tick_calls <- res_prec %>%
  distinct(depth, ppm_type, n_calls) %>%
  arrange(ppm_type, depth) %>%
  mutate(tick = paste0(as.character(depth), "\n(calls=", n_calls, ")"))

tick_map <- tick_calls %>%
  select(ppm_type, depth, tick) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = depth, values_from = tick)

make_depth_ticks <- function(ppm_type) {
  z <- tick_calls %>% filter(ppm_type == !!ppm_type)
  setNames(z$tick, z$depth)
}

# ---- common theme: add grid (not too heavy) ----
theme_grid <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.text.x = element_text(lineheight = 0.95)
    )
}

plot_precision <- function(df, ppm_type_label, upper=1, step=0.1) {
  depth_ticks <- make_depth_ticks(ppm_type_label)

  ggplot(df %>% filter(ppm_type == ppm_type_label),
         aes(x = depth, y = precision, color = truth_def, group = truth_def)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2.3) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = depth_ticks) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, upper),
                        breaks = seq(0, upper, by = step),
                        labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("ppmSeq ", ppm_type_label, " - Precision"),
      x = "Depth",
      y = "Precision",
      color = "Truth"
    ) +
    theme_grid()
}

plot_tp <- function(df, ppm_type_label) {
  depth_ticks <- make_depth_ticks(ppm_type_label)

  ggplot(df %>% filter(ppm_type == ppm_type_label),
         aes(x = depth, y = TP, color = truth_def, group = truth_def)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2.3) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = depth_ticks) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("ppmSeq ", ppm_type_label, " - TP"),
      x = "Depth",
      y = "BAM-level validation count (TP)",
      color = "Truth"
    ) +
    theme_grid()
}

# ---- 4 plots ----
p_prec_multi <- plot_precision(res_prec, "multiread", 0.5, 0.1)
p_tp_multi   <- plot_tp(res_prec, "multiread")
p_prec_sing  <- plot_precision(res_prec, "singleton_HC", 0.1, 0.02)
p_tp_sing    <- plot_tp(res_prec, "singleton_HC")

p_prec_multi
p_tp_multi
p_prec_sing
p_tp_sing
```

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(pscl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---- load ----
hist_df <- read_tsv("coverage/ppmseq_7614_coverage_hist.merged.tsv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(depth, count) %>%
  mutate(depth = as.integer(depth),
         count = as.numeric(count)) %>%
  arrange(depth)

total <- sum(hist_df$count)
zero_count <- hist_df$count[match(0L, hist_df$depth)]
if (is.na(zero_count)) zero_count <- 0
obs_coverage <- 1 - (zero_count / total)

# ---- fit ----
dat <- hist_df %>% mutate(y = depth, w = count)

m_zip  <- zeroinfl(y ~ 1 | 1, data = dat, weights = w, dist = "poisson")
m_zinb <- zeroinfl(y ~ 1 | 1, data = dat, weights = w, dist = "negbin")

zip_pi     <- plogis(unname(m_zip$coefficients$zero[1]))
zip_lambda <- exp(unname(m_zip$coefficients$count[1]))

zinb_pi    <- plogis(unname(m_zinb$coefficients$zero[1]))
zinb_mu    <- exp(unname(m_zinb$coefficients$count[1]))
zinb_theta <- m_zinb$theta
zinb_alpha <- 1 / zinb_theta
# ---- pmf ----
pmf_zip <- function(k, pi, lambda){
  ifelse(k == 0,
         pi + (1 - pi) * dpois(0, lambda),
         (1 - pi) * dpois(k, lambda))
}

pmf_zinb <- function(k, pi, mu, theta){
  ifelse(k == 0,
         pi + (1 - pi) * dnbinom(0, mu = mu, size = theta),
         (1 - pi) * dnbinom(k, mu = mu, size = theta))
}

max_depth <- max(hist_df$depth)
ks <- 0:max_depth

pred_df <- tibble(
  depth = ks,
  ZIP  = pmf_zip(ks, zip_pi, zip_lambda),
  ZINB = pmf_zinb(ks, zinb_pi, zinb_mu, zinb_theta)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ZIP, ZINB),
               names_to = "model",
               values_to = "prob")

plot_df <- hist_df %>%
  mutate(frac = count / sum(count))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(depth, frac)) +
  geom_col(fill="grey80") +
  geom_line(data=pred_df,
            aes(depth, prob, colour=model),
            linewidth=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%",100*x)) +
  labs(title="ZIP vs ZINB fit",
       subtitle=paste0(
         "ZIP: pi=",round(zip_pi,3),
         ", lambda=",round(zip_lambda,2),
         " | ZINB: pi=",round(zinb_pi,3),
         ", mu=",round(zinb_mu,2),
         ", alpha=",round(zinb_alpha,3),
         " | coverage=",round(100*obs_coverage,1),"%"
       ),
       x="Depth",
       y="Fraction of loci") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)

hist_df <- read_tsv("coverage/ppmseq_7614_coverage_hist.merged.tsv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(depth, count) %>%
  mutate(depth = as.integer(depth),
         count = as.numeric(count)) %>%
  arrange(depth)

# Expand histogram into per-locus vector (can be big; use weighted approach instead)
# glmmTMB supports weights directly
dat <- hist_df %>% transmute(y = depth, w = count)

m_zinb <- glmmTMB(
  y ~ 1,
  ziformula = ~ 1,
  family = nbinom2(),   # NB2: Var = mu + mu^2/theta  => alpha = 1/theta
  weights = w,
  data = dat
)

# Parameters
zinb_pi <- plogis(unname(fixef(m_zinb)$zi[1]))     # zero-inflation mixing pi
zinb_mu <- exp(unname(fixef(m_zinb)$cond[1]))      # mean mu
zinb_theta <- sigma(m_zinb)                        # theta in nbinom2
zinb_alpha <- 1 / zinb_theta                       # alpha (NB2)

c(pi = zinb_pi, mu = zinb_mu, theta = zinb_theta, alpha = zinb_alpha)
```

```{r}
# ---- Build matrix for UpSetR (missing cols -> 0) ----
make_mat_strata <- function(df, cols) {
  out <- lapply(cols, function(x) {
    if (x %in% colnames(df)) as.integer(df[[x]] %in% 1) else rep(0L, nrow(df))
  })
  mat <- as.data.frame(out, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(mat) <- cols
  rownames(mat) <- NULL
  mat
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
r_overpois <- function(n, lambda, alpha) {
  shape <- 1 / alpha
  rate  <- 1 / (alpha * lambda)
  
  lam_g <- rgamma(n, shape = shape, rate = rate)
  rpois(n, lam_g)
}
#%>% ggplot(., aes(x=count))+geom_histogram(, binwidth = 10)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(stringr)


trin <- read_tsv("trinuc32_all_methods_wide.tsv")

# ---- 1) matrix + normalize (each column sums to 1) ----
mat_raw <- trin %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("trinuc") %>%
  as.matrix()

mat_norm <- apply(mat_raw, 2, function(x) x / sum(x))

# ---- 2) cosine similarity + distance(for clustering) ----
cos_sim <- function(m) {
  m_scaled <- apply(m, 2, function(x) x / sqrt(sum(x^2)))
  t(m_scaled) %*% m_scaled
}

sim_mat  <- cos_sim(mat_norm)
dist_mat <- 1 - sim_mat  # cosine distance

# ---- 3) clustering by cosine distance ----
hc <- hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = "average")

# ---- 4) annotation (same as you had) ----
samples <- colnames(dist_mat)

tissue <- dplyr::case_when(
  str_detect(samples, "7614") ~ "7614",
  str_detect(samples, "6566_blood") ~ "6566_blood",
  str_detect(samples, "6566_sperm") ~ "6566_sperm",
  str_detect(samples, "(^|_)6566($|_)") ~ "6566_sperm",
  str_detect(samples, "ref_hg38") ~ "reference",
  TRUE ~ "unknown"
)

platform <- dplyr::case_when(
  str_detect(samples, "^ppmseq") ~ "ppmseq",
  str_detect(samples, "^illumina") ~ "illumina",
  str_detect(samples, "^nanoseq") ~ "nanoseq",
  str_detect(samples, "^udseq") ~ "udseq",
  str_detect(samples, "^hidef") ~ "hidef",
  str_detect(samples, "^PTA") ~ "PTA",
  str_detect(samples, "ref_hg38") ~ "reference",
  TRUE ~ "other"
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  tissue = tissue,
  platform = platform,
  col = list(
    tissue = c(
      "7614" = "#1b9e77",
      "6566_sperm" = "#d95f02",
      "6566_blood" = "#7570b3",
      "reference" = "grey40",
      "unknown" = "grey80"
    ),
    platform = c(
      ppmseq = "#66c2a5",
      illumina = "#fc8d62",
      nanoseq = "#8da0cb",
      udseq = "#e78ac3",
      hidef = "#a6d854",
      PTA = "#ffd92f",
      reference = "black",
      other = "grey50"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# ---- 5) log-scale coloring on distance, but legend labels in distance units ----

# Make diagonal NA (so it doesn't dominate; dist=0 => log blow-up)
dist_mat2 <- dist_mat
diag(dist_mat2) <- NA_real_

# z is what we actually plot for colors
z_mat <- -log10(dist_mat2)
diag(z_mat) <- NA_real_

# Robust range from off-diagonal only
z_off <- z_mat[upper.tri(z_mat)]
z_off <- z_off[is.finite(z_off)]
z_lo <- as.numeric(quantile(z_off, 0.05, names = FALSE))
z_hi <- as.numeric(quantile(z_off, 0.995, names = FALSE))

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(z_lo, (z_lo + z_hi) / 2, z_hi),
  c("#440154", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf")
)

# Legend ticks: choose integer z ticks within range (cap to <=5 ticks)
k_min <- max(0, floor(z_lo))
k_max <- max(k_min + 1, ceiling(z_hi))
k_all <- seq(k_min, k_max)

if (length(k_all) > 5) {
  k_at <- unique(round(seq(k_min, k_max, length.out = 5)))
} else {
  k_at <- k_all
}

legend_labels <- ifelse(
  k_at == 0,
  "1",
  paste0("1e-", k_at)
)

alpha <- 0.25
hc2 <- hc
hc2$height <- hc$height^alpha

ht <- Heatmap(
  z_mat,
  name = "Cosine Distance",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "white",
  cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(hc2),
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc2),
  row_dend_width = grid::unit(40, "mm"),        
  column_dend_height = grid::unit(40, "mm"),    
  top_annotation = ha,
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Cosine Distance",
    at = rev(k_at),
    labels = rev(legend_labels)
  )
)

pdf()
draw(ht)
```

```{r}
# ---- 1) De novo rename map: SBS96A->Sig1 ... SBS96D->Sig4 ----
denovo_map <- c(
  "Signature 96-A" = "Sig1",
  "Signature 96-B" = "Sig2",
  "Signature 96-C" = "Sig3",
  "Signature 96-D" = "Sig4",
  "SBS96A" = "Sig1",
  "SBS96B" = "Sig2",
  "SBS96C" = "Sig3",
  "SBS96D" = "Sig4"
)

# ---- 2) Parse "Global NMF Signatures" into long df: (denovo, cosmic, pct) ----
# cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf columns:
# `De novo extracted`, `Global NMF Signatures`, ...
df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf <- cosmic_refit_mutSig_vcf %>%
  transmute(
    denovo_raw = `De novo extracted`,
    mix_raw = `Global NMF Signatures`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    denovo = recode(denovo_raw, !!!denovo_map, .default = denovo_raw),
    # Split by '&'
    mix_raw = str_replace_all(mix_raw, "\\s*&\\s*", "&"),
    parts = str_split(mix_raw, "&", simplify = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_longer(parts) %>%
  mutate(
    parts = str_trim(parts),
    # Extract SBS id + percent in parentheses
    cosmic = str_extract(parts, "SBS\\d+"),
    pct = as.numeric(str_match(parts, "\\(([-0-9.]+)%\\)")[,2])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cosmic), !is.na(pct)) %>%
  select(denovo, cosmic, pct)

# ---- 3) Plot: bubble, fill by cosmic (pastel), label pct ----
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

# ---- make matrix: rows = 96 contexts, cols = samples ----
mat_96 <- vcf_trinuc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("MutationType") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- cosine similarity between samples (columns) ----
cos_sim_cols <- function(m){
  m_scaled <- apply(m, 2, function(x){
    s2 <- sum(x^2)
    if (s2 == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
    x / sqrt(s2)
  })
  t(m_scaled) %*% m_scaled
}

sim_96 <- cos_sim_cols(mat_96)

# ---- cosine distance + clustering ----
dist_96 <- 1 - sim_96
dist_96[dist_96 < 0] <- 0
diag(dist_96) <- 0

hc_96 <- hclust(as.dist(dist_96), method = "average")


col_fun <- colorRamp2(

    "#08306B")
)
ht <- Heatmap(

  name = "Cosine\nSimilarity",

  column_dend_height = unit(30, "mm"),

  column_names_rot = 45,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "0.75", "0.9", "1"),
    title = "Cosine similarity"
  )
)

draw(ht)
```

```{r}
## ---- BAM Evidence: bubble (SigA-E vs COSMIC) ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ---- rename map: SBS96A->SigA ... SBS96E->SigE ----
denovo_map_bam <- c(
  "Signature 96-SBS96A" = "SigA",
  "Signature 96-SBS96B" = "SigB",
  "Signature 96-SBS96C" = "SigC",
  "Signature 96-SBS96D" = "SigD",
  "Signature 96-SBS96E" = "SigE",
  "SBS96A" = "SigA",
  "SBS96B" = "SigB",
  "SBS96C" = "SigC",
  "SBS96D" = "SigD",
  "SBS96E" = "SigE"
)

# ---- COSMIC colors (reuse overlaps; add new) ----
cosmic_cols_bam <- c(
  SBS1  = "#A8DADC",
  SBS2  = "#F4A261",
  SBS3  = "#BFD3E6",
  SBS4  = "#C7E9C0",
  SBS5  = "#8EC9B8",
  SBS12 = "#FDD0A2",
  SBS16 = "#B8A1D9",
  SBS31 = "#F6BD60",
  SBS32 = "#9DB4E0",
  SBS51 = "#D9D9D9"

  # new in BAM

)

# ---- parse refit table into long df ----
df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_bamEvidence <- cosmic_refit_mutSig_bamEvidence %>%
  transmute(
    denovo_raw = `De novo extracted`,
    mix_raw = `Global NMF Signatures`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    denovo = recode(denovo_raw, !!!denovo_map_bam, .default = denovo_raw),
    mix_raw = str_replace_all(mix_raw, "\\s*&\\s*", "&"),
    parts = str_split(mix_raw, "&", simplify = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_longer(parts) %>%
  mutate(
    parts = str_trim(parts),
    cosmic = str_extract(parts, "SBS\\d+"),
    pct = as.numeric(str_match(parts, "\\(([-0-9.]+)%\\)")[,2])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cosmic), !is.na(pct)) %>%
  select(denovo, cosmic, pct)

y_levels_bam <- c("SigA","SigB","SigC","SigD","SigE")
x_levels_bam <- names(cosmic_cols_bam)

p1_bam <- ggplot(
  df_cosmic_refit_mutSig_bamEvidence %>%
    mutate(
      cosmic = factor(cosmic, levels = x_levels_bam),
      denovo = factor(denovo, levels = y_levels_bam)
    )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = cosmic, y = denovo, size = pct, fill = cosmic),
    shape = 21,
    color = "grey20",
    stroke = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = cosmic, y = denovo, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    size = 3.0,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cosmic_cols_bam, name = "COSMIC") +
  scale_size(
    range = c(9, 18),
    breaks = c(10, 25, 50, 75),
    name = "Contribution (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(factor(y_levels_bam)))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p1_bam
```

```{r}
## ---- BAM Evidence: sample-sample cosine similarity heatmap (96D) ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

# ---- matrix: rows = 96 contexts, cols = samples ----
mat_96_bam <- bamEvidence_trinuc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("MutationType") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- cosine similarity between samples (columns) ----
cos_sim_cols <- function(m){
  m_scaled <- apply(m, 2, function(x){
    s2 <- sum(x^2)
    if (s2 == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
    x / sqrt(s2)
  })
  t(m_scaled) %*% m_scaled
}

sim_96_bam <- cos_sim_cols(mat_96_bam)

# ---- cosine distance + clustering ----
dist_96_bam <- 1 - sim_96_bam
dist_96_bam[dist_96_bam < 0] <- 0
diag(dist_96_bam) <- 0
hc_96_bam <- hclust(as.dist(dist_96_bam), method = "average")

# ---- color (0-1) ----
col_fun_blue <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
  c("#FFFFFF", "#E3EEF9", "#9ECAE1", "#2171B5", "#08306B")
)

ht_bam <- Heatmap(
  sim_96_bam,
  name = "Cosine\nSimilarity",
  col = col_fun_blue,
  cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(hc_96_bam),
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc_96_bam),
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(30, "mm"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 45,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "0.75", "0.9", "1"),
    title = "Cosine similarity"
  )
)

draw(ht_bam)
```
